claimText: Morning Mood (easier chords): Grieg's own piano arrangement (G. Schirmer, 1899) as read in transcription A, the right hand's melody unchanged, every chord rewritten to fit one hand
outcomeNote: Arranged 2026-10-02 at the owner's request from transcription A so that every moment fits one hand per staff (Constitution 1.4.0, Principle VII: at most three keys, an octave struck together, a sixth for a held note; tests/library/playability.test.ts). The faithful item has 154 moments beyond those limits, this one none. Reviewed by the music-domain-expert role (bass kept in bars 4 and 12, the trill bars' held D#4, the sevenths of bars 45 and 77-78 fixed). Every change is commented "arr:" in the source; the right hand's melody is transcription A's, note for note.
